_note: Where each photo came from. Every file in src/images/ that fills a page slot needs an entry here. `own` means a photograph of this business's own work, taken by or for the business. Anything else is stock and must record its licence and source URL — some licences require attribution, and in a year nobody will remember which ones did.
_ownFlag: business.photos.own can only be set true when EVERY slot below is `own`. check:content enforces that. This is the guard that stops a set of stock photos being captioned as our installs, which is a misleading representation under the Australian Consumer Law.
_howToAdd: Add one entry per file, keyed by filename without the extension. For stock: {"source": "stock", "licence": "Unsplash", "url": "https://unsplash.com/photos/...", "credit": "Photographer Name"}. For ours: {"source": "own"}.
